route.routing_reason: High-risk coding work benefits from a strong model and review.
route.fallback: If review execution is unavailable, continue with the worker result and flag the missing review.

worker_briefs.title: Implement change
worker_briefs.objective: Implement the requested change in the repo.
constraints: Keep the change scoped to the requested feature.
Run targeted verification before reporting success.
worker_briefs.expected_output: A concise implementation summary with verification evidence.

reviewer_brief.title: Review implementation
reviewer_brief.objective: Review the worker result for regressions and missing verification.
constraints: Focus on correctness, risk, and evidence.
reviewer_brief.expected_output: A pass/fail review with concrete findings.
acceptance_criteria: Any regression risk is called out clearly.

execution_plan.synthesis_strategy: Combine the worker output with review findings into one final response.

worker_results.output: Implemented the change and verified the requested behavior.

review_result.output: No regressions found in the scoped change.
